g.text: paler = lower identity to the home gene
more than one copy at the locus
one copy; numbered along the chromosome
gene model: coding exons to scale, ∧ = intron; drawn 5′→3′
aligned hits without a gene model
weak call (needs curation, or no significant match)
searched, no model placed (not evidence of absence)
fill and outline: confidence, as for the flanking genes
after a GOI model: % identity to the query; bold = high confidence
